<SPAN 1>THIS CONFIDENTIALITY AND NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (the “Agreement”) made this day of , (the “Effective Date”) by and between a corporation, and a corporation, (collectively, the “Parties” and each individually a “Party”).</SPAN 1>
<SPAN 2>The Parties are exploring the possibility of engaging in one or more mutually beneficial business relationships (collectively, the “Business Relationship”). </SPAN 2><SPAN 3>The Parties recognize that in the course of their discussions to further the Business Relationship, it will be necessary for each Party to disclose to the other certain Confidential Information (as defined below). </SPAN 3><SPAN 4>Each Party desires to set forth the terms that apply to such Confidential Information.</SPAN 4>
<SPAN 5>NOW, THEREFORE, for and in consideration of the foregoing, of the promises and covenants set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties do hereby agree as follows:</SPAN 5>
<SPAN 6>1. The Parties shall </SPAN 6><SPAN 7>(i) use reasonable efforts to maintain the confidentiality of the information and materials, whether oral, written or in any form whatsoever, of the other that may be reasonably understood, from legends, the nature of such information itself and/or the circumstances of such information’s disclosure, to be confidential and/or proprietary thereto or to third parties to which either of them owes a duty of nondisclosure (collectively, “Confidential Information”); </SPAN 7><SPAN 8>(ii) take reasonable action in connection therewith, including without limitation at least the action that each takes to protect the confidentiality of its comparable proprietary assets; </SPAN 8><SPAN 9>(iii) to the extent within their respective possession and/or control, upon termination of this Agreement for any reason, immediately return to the provider thereof all Confidential Information not licensed or authorized to be used or enjoyed after termination or expiration hereof, and </SPAN 9><SPAN 10>(iv) with respect to any person to which disclosure is contemplated, require such person to execute an agreement providing for the treatment of Confidential Information set forth in clauses </SPAN 10><SPAN 11>(i) through </SPAN 11><SPAN 12>(iii). </SPAN 12><SPAN 13>The foregoing shall not require separate written agreements with employees and agents already subject to written agreements substantially conforming to the requirements of this Section nor with legal counsel, certified public accountants, or other professional advisers under a professional obligation to maintain the confidences of clients.</SPAN 13>
<SPAN 14>2. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the obligation of a person to protect the confidentiality of any information or materials shall terminate as to any information or materials which: </SPAN 14><SPAN 15>(i) are, or become, public knowledge through no act or failure to act of such person; </SPAN 15><SPAN 16>(ii) are publicly disclosed by the proprietor thereof; </SPAN 16><SPAN 17>(iii) are lawfully obtained without obligations of confidentiality by such person from a third party after reasonable inquiry regarding the authority of such third party to possess and divulge the same; </SPAN 17><SPAN 18>(iv) are independently developed by such person from sources or through persons that such person can demonstrate had no access to Confidential Information; or </SPAN 18><SPAN 19>(v) are lawfully known by such person at the time of disclosure other than by reason of discussions with or disclosures by the Parties.</SPAN 19>
<SPAN 20>3. All Confidential Information delivered pursuant to this Agreement shall be and remain the property of the disclosing Party, and any documents containing or reflecting the Confidential Information, and all copies thereof, shall be promptly returned to the disclosing Party upon written request, or destroyed at the disclosing Party’s option. </SPAN 20><SPAN 21>Nothing herein shall be construed as granting or conferring any rights by license or otherwise, express or implied, regarding any idea made, conceived or acquired prior to or after the Effective Date, nor as granting any right with respect to the use or marketing of any product or service. </SPAN 21><SPAN 22>The Parties shall use the Confidential Information only for the Business Relationship. </SPAN 22><SPAN 23>The obligations of the Parties under this Agreement shall continue and survive the completion or abandonment of the Business Relationship and shall remain binding for a period of two (2) years from the Effective Date.</SPAN 23>
<SPAN 24>4. As a violation by either Party of this Agreement could cause irreparable injury to the other Party and as there is no adequate remedy at law for such violation, the non-breaching Party may, in addition to any other remedies available to it at law or in equity, enjoin the breaching Party in a court of equity for violating or threatening to violate this Agreement. </SPAN 24><SPAN 25>In the event either Party is required to enforce this Agreement through legal action, then it will be entitled to recover from the other Party all costs incurred thereby, including without limitation, reasonable attorney’s fees.</SPAN 25>
<SPAN 26>5. Neither Party makes any representation or warranty with respect to any Confidential Information disclosed by it, nor shall either Party or any of their respective representatives have any liability hereunder with respect to the accuracy or completeness of any Confidential Information or the use thereof.</SPAN 26>
<SPAN 27>6. Any provision of this Agreement held or determined by a court (or other legal authority) of competent jurisdiction to be illegal, invalid, or unenforceable in any jurisdiction shall be deemed separate, distinct and independent, and shall be ineffective to the extent of such holding or determination without </SPAN 27><SPAN 28>(i) invalidating the remaining provisions of this Agreement in that jurisdiction or </SPAN 28><SPAN 29>(ii) affecting the legality, validity or enforceability of such provision in any other jurisdiction.</SPAN 29>
<SPAN 30>7. Any notice required or permitted to be given hereunder shall be </SPAN 30><SPAN 31>(a) in writing, </SPAN 31><SPAN 32>(b) effective on the first business day following the date of receipt, and </SPAN 32><SPAN 33>(c) delivered by one of the following means: </SPAN 33><SPAN 34>(i) by personal delivery; </SPAN 34><SPAN 35>(ii) by prepaid, overnight package delivery or courier service; or </SPAN 35><SPAN 36>(iii) by the United States Postal Service, first class, certified mail, return receipt requested, postage prepaid. </SPAN 36><SPAN 37>All notices given under this Agreement shall be addressed to the addresses stated at the outset of this Agreement, or to new or additional addresses as the Parties may be advised in writing.</SPAN 37>
<SPAN 38>8. <SPAN 41>9. guidance.when: The source expressly makes return or destruction of protected information operative upon termination, expiration, rejection, or conclusion of the agreement, project, or contemplated relationship.
guidance.inspection: Separate the operative return or destruction duty from request-only duties, then verify that the stated trigger is an ending event and carry forward any scope limits or exceptions.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Cite the ending-event trigger together with the operative return or destruction language; include a governing list introduction when the duty is an item.

guidance.when: The source expressly exempts identified copies or stored protected information from a return or deletion duty and permits their continued retention.
guidance.inspection: Read the general return or destruction rule with every overriding exception; identify what may remain, who or what system may hold it, its purpose, and continuing restrictions.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Cite the retention permission and any governing exception transition, plus material limits such as archival-only access, dispute purpose, or continuing confidentiality.

guidance.when: The source expressly prohibits disclosure of the existence or occurrence of negotiations, discussions, an agreement in progress, receipt of evaluation material, or terms or status of the contemplated transaction.
guidance.inspection: Distinguish secrecy of the deal process or agreement facts from ordinary secrecy of confidential information, and preserve consent, audience, and publicity qualifications.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Cite the prohibition's governing language and each relied-on enumerated subject; a generic nondisclosure clause alone is insufficient.

guidance.when: A source clause expressly addresses making, reproducing, automatically creating, returning, destroying, or retaining copies of protected information.
guidance.inspection: Classify the copy language by legal function: affirmative exception, automatic-copy acknowledgement, consent-conditioned prohibition, mere reference to existing copies, return duty, or retention carve-out. Do not infer creation permission from employee access or generic safeguarding.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Cite the operative copy wording and its governing condition or exception; read adjacent retention or return language when it changes the clause's function.

guidance.when: The source expressly states that the agreement or disclosure grants, conveys, or confers no right or license in protected information or associated intellectual property.
guidance.inspection: Identify the denied grant separately from ownership, limited-purpose use, and review permissions; preserve any express narrow exception without treating it as a general license.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Cite the operative no-rights or no-license wording and any material exception; ownership language may be retained as independent support but is not a substitute for an express grant denial.

guidance.when: The source expressly limits use of protected information to a stated agreement, transaction, evaluation, project, discussion, or business-relationship purpose, whether phrased as 'only' or as a prohibition with a necessary-purpose exception.
guidance.inspection: Treat the permitted purpose as the boundary of the restriction, not as permission for unrelated uses; capture both affirmative only-use wording and complementary other-purpose prohibitions.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Cite the operative use limitation and the text identifying the permitted purpose; include a governing introduction when the rule is listed.
